purpose: Discover account-level Tesla energy installations and inspect cached site capabilities, configuration and tariff settings.
primaryGoal: Review installed Powerwall/solar products, refresh Tesla discovery/configuration and update an eligible site's rate plan.

identity.scope: Assigned page and dependencies only; route source checks do not establish mounted reachability.

dataSources.behavior: Account-level cached discovery; key ['tesla-energy-sites']; STANDARD stale time; abort signal forwarded; safeArray selection; DataState retains refresh-failure payload.
Pending disables refresh; success invalidates discovery query; localized success/error toasts. Not executed.
Per-site independent query ['tesla-site-info', siteId], enabled for truthy ID, SLOW stale time, abort signal forwarded; response is {data,fetched_at}.
Invalidates only matching site query, localized toast; also called after successful tariff update. Not executed.
JSON payload, requiresLiveMode true, invalidateAndBroadcast on success; request client enforces operational-write policy at client.ts:378. No live mutation performed.

components.contract: Named group, stable item IDs, half-size items; shared measured-container packing and card title/actions/footer.

components.name: SummaryBand / BatteryEvidenceBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Six metrics, explicit snapshot/provenance, loading and retained evidence; delegates shared rendering and details.

components.name: StatStrip
components.contract: Embedded typed metrics, stable IDs, period and retained flag; existing preferences owner.

components.contract: Feature-owned product/configuration presentation, independent config state and capability chips.

components.name: SourceTrustNotice
components.contract: DataState retained warnings, paused first-load explanation and query retry.

components.name: TOUSettingsModal
components.contract: Existing Modal/Tabs/Select/Textarea/Button; three presets and custom JSON envelope support, validation, pending protection.

components.contract: Reuse canonical shared controls, semantic palette, typography, gauge and state/motion owners, not feature replacements.

duplicatedPatterns.decision: Reuse feature CapBadge with explicit textual state for configuration capabilities; preserve dynamic identities and unknown values. No speculative global registry.
Already centralized locally; preserve magnitude-based Wh/kWh and W/kW semantics while connecting numeric metrics to canonical display formatter support.

sourceEvidence.detail: Measured-container bands <640, <1024, <1600; half cards stack in phone/tablet bands, become six columns on desktop, with source order preserved.
min-w-0, flex-wrap action header, single-column tiles then sm two columns; tariff text breaks words; controls min-h-11.
JSON preview has its own overflow-auto/max-h-48; actual viewport containment unverified.

unverifiedRisks: Long site names, battery types and site identifiers inside half cards
Long localized action labels and tariff modal controls at 320px
200% text, RTL, allocated-width reflow and JSON horizontal overflow

positiveEvidence: Refresh actions have localized accessible names; site controls have 44px minimum targets.
Shared cards associate headings with cards, CardGrid labels its group; most decorative feature icons are aria-hidden.
TOU error uses canonical ErrorText role=alert; shared FadeIn respects reduced motion in source.

issues.detail: Available/unavailable is in aria-label but the visible chip only says the capability name; sighted users distinguish boolean state primarily through success versus neutral color. SiteInfoSection.tsx:88 also renders true and false component chips with identical visible names.
issues.fix: Keep capability identities and show localized available/unavailable text or an unambiguous state icon plus text in both chip presentations; do not treat unknown as false.

accessibility.runtime: Keyboard, screen-reader naming, modal focus/restore, target spacing, contrast, forced-colors and reduced-motion behavior unverified.

states.loading: Root suppresses skeletons when retained data exists; summary loading state plus two card skeletons; each configuration has independent skeleton.
states.empty: Resolved empty discovery shows six measured count/aggregate zeros and an actionable explanation referencing the existing refresh action; no invented installations.
states.initialUnavailable: No successful snapshot displays unknown summary metrics, not fabricated zeros; initial paused load gets offline notice.
states.fatalError: Root QueryError in summary plus discovery unavailable explanation; configuration failure stays inside its site's section.
states.refreshError: Retained payload preserved through DataState; SourceTrustNotice reports refresh warnings beside retained content.
states.offline: Paused/no-data notice and retained stale behavior are source-supported; actual network behavior unverified.
states.partial: Missing capacity makes total capacity unknown; individual configuration availability does not block neighboring sites.
states.mutation: Discovery/configuration pending guards and toasts; TOU validation/pending/error UI, live-mode write gate, refresh-after-success.

issues.detail: Fatal GET configuration error wires QueryError retry to POST Tesla refresh rather than infoQuery.refetch; another Refresh site info button already owns the remote refresh. This changes the recovery operation and invokes a rate-limited mutation.
issues.fix: Wire query retry to infoQuery.refetch/source.retry and retain the distinct explicit Tesla refresh action.

visualIssues.detail: Preset preview uses fixed white background/border opacity instead of neutral surface/border tokens. Source contains no neon/glow matches, but this preview is a remaining theme-inconsistent surface.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing surface-2 and border-subtle tokens like InfoTile; preserve preview content and scroll behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: EnergySiteCard directly imports layout/layout-reference and data-display/stat-reference. SiteInfoSection.tsx:5 and SummaryBand.tsx:2 also import internal stat-reference exports, unlike the page's canonical category imports.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing @/components/layout and @/components/data-display exports without introducing replacement components.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-033 / MDC-045: retain numeric raw measurements
architectureIssues.detail: Charge and capacity are converted to text rawValue; SiteInfoSection.tsx:35-36 also formats rated W/Wh as text. This bypasses canonical numeric metric validation/conversion and raw accessible/details evidence. SummaryBand already supplies numeric energy with a specialist formatter.
architectureIssues.fix: Use numeric percentage/energy/power metric contracts with the existing specialist display formatter where needed; preserve exact magnitude-based formatting, locale/precision, missing distinctions and SI cache/wire values.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044: localized presentation without source recasing
architectureIssues.detail: Component labels are generated by key.replace(/_/g, ' ') and bypass translation; dynamic upstream keys are not a canonical presentation glossary.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize known component identities, preserve unknown original keys as source identifiers, and retain every boolean entry and state.

priority.reason: Page already uses canonical layout/trust patterns and preserves major functionality; address color-only capability state, raw numeric metric mapping and distinct query recovery before cosmetic changes.

sharedContracts.decision: Reuse existing contract; caller import correction only.

sharedContracts.name: Typed operational metrics
sharedContracts.decision: Reuse; preserve specialty formatter semantics. Formatter internals not audited here; no unsupported new shared API demanded.

sharedContracts.name: Capability chips
sharedContracts.decision: Badge already supports children/ARIA; feature adoption fix, not a new global status registry.

sharedContracts.name: Source trust
sharedContracts.decision: Keep canonical source contract and distinct Tesla refresh/query retry actions.

competingImplementations.detail: CapBadge feature wrapper versus inline SiteInfoSection boolean Badge loop; consolidate locally only where semantics are equivalent.
Numeric energy specialist formatter in summary versus preformatted text metrics in site/configuration strips; converge on existing stats owner, not another formatter engine.

workspace.evidence: workspaceScope.ts:23-77 excludes route from dated analysis; :119 disables vehicle selector. Account-level installation discovery correctly introduces no competing local workspace picker.

preservation.SI: Frontend assumes total_pack_energy/nameplate_energy are Wh and nameplate_power is W in helpers.ts:6-13. Backend payload units were not independently inspected; preserve current SI/display behavior and explicitly resolve source-unit ambiguity before changing conversions.
